question: India's first satellite ______ was completely designed and fabricated in India. On 19 April 1975, it was launch by a Russian space launched vehicle named 'Kosmos-3M' from the site Kapustin Yar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aryabhata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Aryabhata was India's first satellite, named after the ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Aryabhata.
 
• It was completely designed and fabricated in India by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• The satellite was launched on 19 April 1975 by a Russian space launch vehicle named 'Kosmos-3M' from the site Kapustin Yar.
 
• Aryabhata marked a significant milestone in India's space program, laying the foundation for future satellite development and space exploration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**

 
 
• ISRO is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
 
• It was founded on 15 August 1969 with the vision to harness space technology for national development while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration.
 
• ISRO has achieved numerous milestones, including the successful launch of the Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) and the Chandrayaan missions to the moon.
 
• The organization aims to develop space technology and its applications to various national tasks.
 
 
 
• **Kapustin Yar**
 
 
• Kapustin Yar is a Russian rocket launch and development site located in Astrakhan Oblast, Russia.
 
• It was established in 1946 and has been used for various purposes, including missile testing, satellite launches, and scientific research.
 
• Kapustin Yar played a crucial role in the early development of the Soviet and Russian space programs.
 
 
 
• **Kosmos-3M**
 
 
• The Kosmos-3M is a Russian space launch vehicle used to place satellites into orbit.
 
• It was developed by the Yuzhnoye Design Bureau in Ukraine and has been in service since 1967.
 
• The vehicle is known for its reliability and has been used to launch various types of satellites, including communications, weather, and scientific satellites.
 
 
 
• **Aryabhata**
 
 
• Aryabhata was India's first satellite, launched on 19 April 1975.
 
• The satellite was named after the ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Aryabhata.
 
• It was designed for conducting experiments in X-ray astronomy, solar physics, and aeronomy.
 
• Although it faced some technical issues post-launch, Aryabhata provided valuable data and experience for ISRO.
